name: IntakeQ/PracticeQ vs SimplePractice
title: IntakeQ/PracticeQ vs SimplePractice: EHR Comparison 2026
description: Compare IntakeQ/PracticeQ and SimplePractice for mental health practices. See pricing, customization, features, and which platform is best for your practice.

summary.bottom_line: IntakeQ/PracticeQ excels in customizable intake forms and flexibility, making it ideal for practices with unique workflows. SimplePractice offers a more polished, all-in-one experience with better mobile apps and broader market adoption (250,000+ practitioners). Choose based on whether customization or user experience is your priority.

sections.heading: IntakeQ/PracticeQ vs SimplePractice: Overview
sections.content: IntakeQ started as a digital intake forms solution and evolved into PracticeQ, a full EHR platform. It's known for highly customizable forms, questionnaires, and assessments with conditional logic and scoring. SimplePractice is one of the most popular practice management platforms with 250,000+ practitioners, known for its user-friendly interface, excellent mobile apps, and comprehensive feature set. Both serve mental health practitioners, but they take different approaches to customization and user experience.

sections.heading: Pricing Comparison
sections.content: IntakeQ offers forms-only pricing at $49.90/month (100 clients) or $99.90/month (unlimited). PracticeQ full EHR starts at $59/month for solo practitioners. SimplePractice starts at $49/month (Starter) with Essential at $79/month and Plus at $99/month. Both have similar price points, but IntakeQ's modular approach lets you pay only for what you need. SimplePractice charges $0.25/claim for billing, while IntakeQ uses Office Ally integration.

sections.heading: Customization vs Polish
sections.content: IntakeQ/PracticeQ excels in form customization - you can build highly branded intake experiences with conditional logic, scoring, and automated workflows using Zapier. SimplePractice offers standard templates that work well but are less flexible. SimplePractice has superior mobile apps (iOS/Android native) while IntakeQ is web-based only. For practitioners with unique intake workflows or who want fully branded client experiences, IntakeQ is the better choice. For those wanting a polished, ready-to-go solution, SimplePractice wins.

sections.heading: Ecosystem & Support
sections.content: SimplePractice has a larger user community and more resources due to its 250,000+ practitioner base. IntakeQ/PracticeQ is bootstrapped and smaller but responsive. Both offer business hours support. SimplePractice has a 30-day free trial vs IntakeQ's 14 days. SimplePractice integrates with more calendar systems (Google, Apple, Outlook) while IntakeQ has better automation capabilities through Zapier.

sections.heading: Which Should You Choose?
sections.content: Choose based on your customization needs:

recommendations.when: You need highly customizable intake forms with conditional logic, branded client experiences, or unique assessment workflows
You want a polished, user-friendly all-in-one platform with excellent mobile apps and don't need extensive customization
You want to automate workflows with Zapier or need GDPR compliance for international clients
You value mobile access, broad calendar integrations, and a large user community with extensive resources

faqs.q: What's the difference between IntakeQ and PracticeQ?
faqs.a: IntakeQ is the intake forms and questionnaire product, while PracticeQ is the full EHR platform built on top of IntakeQ. PracticeQ includes all IntakeQ features plus scheduling, clinical notes, telehealth, billing, and a patient portal.

faqs.q: Which has better intake forms: IntakeQ or SimplePractice?
faqs.a: IntakeQ has significantly better intake form customization with a drag-and-drop builder, conditional logic, scoring, and highly branded client experiences. SimplePractice offers standard intake templates that are functional but less flexible.

faqs.q: Does IntakeQ/PracticeQ have a mobile app?
faqs.a: No, IntakeQ/PracticeQ is web-based without native mobile apps. SimplePractice has mobile apps for both iOS and Android. This is a significant advantage for SimplePractice if mobile access is important to you.

faqs.q: Which is more popular: IntakeQ or SimplePractice?
faqs.a: SimplePractice is more widely used with 250,000+ practitioners compared to IntakeQ's 10,000+ practitioners. SimplePractice has a larger community and more third-party resources available.
